The '''contested valley''' was a valley in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that saw significant fighting during the [[Alderaan Civil War|planet's civil war]].
